Pitch-Dark Accord.name: Pitch-Dark Accord
Pitch-Dark Accord.description: The shadow smothers every light and window across a building or a city block at night, drowning the area in darkness, and the user keeps its full strength under control there for the rest of the scene. It grows taller than a truck, strikes any enemy within a street's width for heavy slashing damage on command, and can hold up a falling floor or carry several people at once. Strain: severe.
